purpose: Action plan for cleanup retained inventory. It does not delete files and it does not redefine delete eligibility.

rules.delete_candidate_rule: Only release_state=delete-ready rows may enter a deletion PR.
rules.retained_rule: retained rows are not stale-delete candidates; they need reference migration, replacement proof, or an explicit retention decision.
rules.active_queue_rule: Only VM reruns, raw-trace backfills, staging promotion, or unresolved retention decisions are active cleanup queue items.
rules.operator_rule: Use this plan to reduce blocking references before regenerating cleanup-quarantine-ledger.
